votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of June 3, 2025 and June 10, 2025
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from its June 3, 2025 and June 10, 2025 meetings.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 19 of 2025, CRA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: The Board closed the public hearing and adopted a resolution amending the CRA's final budget for FY 2025-26, including reallocating funding from the Depot District Infrastructure Improvements Program and Program Income Fund to the Depot District Infrastructure Property Acquisition Program, among other adjustments.
